title: Assignment 13 · The parol evidence rule
summary: The parol evidence rule. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Gianni v. R. Russel & Co., Inc.: A tenant could not prove a separate oral promise of exclusive soft-drink sales where the written lease appeared complete and already addressed what he could sell.

Masterson v. Sine: The court allowed evidence of a family agreement limiting assignment of a repurchase option because the deed was not necessarily the complete expression of the parties’ bargain.

Bollinger v. Central Pennsylvania Quarry Stripping and Construction Co.: Proof of a shared drafting omission supported reformation of the writing to include the promised restoration of topsoil.

TeeVee Toons, Inc. v. Gerhard Schubert GmbH: Under the CISG, a factual dispute about the parties’ intent to exclude printed terms—including their merger clause—prevented summary judgment based on those terms.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement §§ 209, 210, 213–216; UCC § 2-202; CISG Article 8; Restatement of Consumer Contracts §§ 8, 9.
